sources.title: BERT Fine-Tuning for Sentiment Classification - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project focuses on building a Sentiment Analysis model using BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers). The pre-trained BERT model is fine-tuned on a labeled dataset to classify text into positive or negative sentiment.

sources.title: Sentiment Classification Using BERT - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: In this post, we will be using BERT architecture for Sentiment classification tasks specifically the architecture used for the CoLA (Corpus of Linguistic Acceptability) binary classification task.

sources.title: ahsansabeeh910/Sentiment-Analyzer-using-BERT-Model - GitHub
sources.snippet: BERT Sentiment Analyzer is an AI-powered web application built using Streamlit, PyTorch, and HuggingFace Transformers for real-time sentiment analysis. The project uses a fine-tuned BERT model to classify text into Positive, Negative, or Neutral sentiments with confidence score visualization and interactive analytics.
